title: Golden CI: use HTTP health endpoint instead of log polling for spectator readiness
description:
Spectator readiness is detected by polling the log file for the marker string "AI Puppeteer: waiting for" (golden_helpers.py _start_spectator, line 559-564). This uses _wait_for_log_marker which polls the file at some interval.

The 16s baseline on warm tests may include polling latency. An HTTP health endpoint (or a signal file written atomically) could provide faster detection of readiness.

The first test's spectator startup is 36-48s vs ~16s for subsequent tests, suggesting the extra time is JVM/class loading cold-cache overhead rather than polling latency. So the savings here are modest — a few seconds per test at best.

Expected savings: ~10-20s total across 10 tests.
